original_benchmark.notes: LongBench v2 (THUDM/LongBench, arXiv:2412.15204): 503 long-context multiple-choice questions (8k-2M words) in six categories. Original harness is a direct zero-shot LLM call (pred.py) scored by accuracy (result.py).

harbor_adapter.notes: All 503 questions adapted; context shipped as /app/context.txt, answer written to /app/answer.txt, deterministic verifier mirroring the official extract_answer parsing. A stratified 176-task parity split is available via --split parity. Parity pending (Scenario 2: fork with a CLI-agent runner).
